I won't say that Tor is untrustworthy, but I will say that you shouldn't use it as your only layer of protection. Tor by itself doesn't fulfill all of a user's privacy needs, and that's just a conservative assessment. If you wanna be super paranoid, even Tor can't be trusted. You'd be better running it than not running it, but I wouldn't put all of my faith in it.

Run Tails OS if you need anything through Tor. I honestly don't trust Tor at all, there are too many rouge nodes out there, but realistically what else is there? Any other onion network have the same limitations.

That's why I say don't use it as your only privacy layer. Multiple methods at once greatly increase your ability to stay hidden. Use any one thing at a time, and you are limited by the vulnerabilities of that thing. Use multiple avenues, and you can counteract those vulnerabilities.
